dsOMOP version on each server

Source: R/versions.R
ds.omop.server.version.Rd

Works on plain DataSHIELD connections, before (or without) ds.omop.connect. For every server it reports the dsOMOP version whose DataSHIELD methods the profile publishes, the version that answers a call (the one installed), and the methods this client calls that the profile does not publish. A server is ready when the two versions agree and nothing is missing; otherwise advice says what to change.

Usage

ds.omop.server.version(conns = NULL, symbol = "omop")

Arguments

conns

DSI connections (default: the DSI default connections).

symbol

OMOP session symbol whose capability blocks (read by ds.omop.connect) are reported.

Value

A data frame with one row per server: server, published (version of the published dsOMOP methods, NA when none), running (version answering omopPingDS, NA when it cannot be called), missing (methods this client calls that the profile lacks), ready, advice and the list column recipe_language: per server the recipe-language capability block of its OMOP session (version, semantic_version, operations, reducers, dialect), independently of method readiness. The string "unavailable" means the connected site supplied no block, or an unconnected site's profile lacks the publication protocol; "not connected" means no OMOP session symbol is connected to a site publishing that protocol. No language capability is inferred from a package version or from ready. The client version is in its "client" attribute.

Details

Opal publishes a package's methods when it is first installed, but not when an installed package is upgraded: after an upgrade the profile keeps the old list until an administrator publishes the package's settings again.

A server whose profile lacks the publication protocol (omopPlanStatusDS, omopStagedRevokeDS) runs v1 plans only through the legacy call and refuses language-2 plans; the advice says whether the installed dsOMOP predates the protocol (install the release that has it, then publish) or its upgraded methods are not published yet (publish again). ready concerns the published methods only: whether a server executes a language-2 plan is its recipe_language block.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ds.omop.client.version()
ds.omop.server.version(conns)
} # }
